bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
echo SINGLE_CREATEVDOBOT=PASS
printf 'SHOP_PUBLIC_URL_DEFINED='
if docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -Eq '^VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL=https://[^ ]+'; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
for name in cloudflared nginx caddy traefik; do
 printf 'HOST_PROCESS_%s=' "$name"
 if pgrep -af "$name" 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E '(pgrep|grep)' >/dev/null; then echo PRESENT; else echo ABSENT; fi
done
printf 'CLOUDFLARED_SERVICE_STATE='
systemctl is-active cloudflared 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'CF_CONFIG_DIR_EXISTS='
if test -d /etc/cloudflared; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
printf 'CF_CONFIG_HAS_HENTAGAY_DOMAIN='
if grep -ERl 'hentaigay[.]org' /etc/cloudflared /home/gace/.cloudflared 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | grep -q .; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
printf 'SHOP_PRIVATE_HTTP_STATUS='
docker exec "$cid" node --input-type=module -e 'const r=await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health");console.log(r.status)' 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'SOURCE_CURRENT_SHA='
git -C /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot rev-parse HEAD
echo READONLY_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE=PASS
